headline: Clinton order aimed at helping disadvantaged-owned small businesses, Historically Black Colleges and Universities, and minority institutions win more federal contracts.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this 1994 executive order directs federal agencies to promote buying goods and services from small businesses owned and controlled by socially and economically disadvantaged people. It also covers Historically Black Colleges and Universities and other minority institutions. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, goals, or steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Small businesses owned by socially and economically disadvantaged individuals
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to increase their chances of getting federal government contracts.

who_it_affects.group: Historically Black Colleges and Universities and other minority institutions
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to increase their share of federal contracting.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that buy goods and services
who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to promote contracting with these businesses and schools.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 16, 1994; exact effective date not stated in the source material.
